Meta.Purpose: A Kotlin Multiplatform Mahjong calculator that uses camera-based tile detection and a complex scoring engine to evaluate Japanese Mahjong hands, calculating Yaku, Fu, and total points.
Meta.Architecture: MVVM/MVI with Voyager ScreenModel and Kotlin-Inject for Dependency Injection.
Meta.AgentProtocol: AGENTS.md defines the strict Zero-Fragmentation protocol for all AI agent interactions.

Package.name: Voyager
Package.purpose: Multiplatform navigation and state management via Screen and ScreenModel interfaces.

Package.name: Kotlin-Inject
Package.purpose: Compile-time dependency injection using KSP for zero-reflection DI.

Package.name: Compose Multiplatform
Package.purpose: Shared UI framework for Android and iOS using Jetpack Compose syntax.

Package.name: Ktor
Package.purpose: Not explicitly in use for networking yet, but common in KMP stacks (absent from current libs.versions.toml).

Package.name: Kotlinx-Coroutines-Test
Package.purpose: Provides unit testing APIs (runTest, StandardTestDispatcher) for suspending functions and Voyager ScreenModels.

SourceSet.name: commonMain
SourceSet.Description: Shared business logic, UI components, and navigation. Contains the Mahjong calculation engine, tile detection abstractions, and Voyager screens/models.

SourceSet.name: androidMain
SourceSet.Description: Android entry point (MainActivity) and platform-specific implementations of Platform and AppComponent.

SourceSet.name: iosMain
SourceSet.Description: iOS entry point (MainViewController), camera feed integration, and platform-specific implementations of Platform and AppComponent.

SourceSet.name: Swift
SourceSet.Description: Native Swift wrapper and entry point for the iOS application, bridging to the ComposeApp framework.

Component.name: MahjongScreenModel
Component.Responsibility: Manages UI state, coordinates hand detection via TileDetectionModel, and orchestrates score calculation using MahjongCalculator.

Component.name: YakuListScreen
Component.Responsibility: Displays a categorized list of Japanese Mahjong Yakus in Korean.

Component.name: YakuCalculationScreen
Component.Responsibility: Provides UI for users to manually select tiles and verify valid Yakus based on the current hand configuration.

Component.name: YakuCalculationScreenModel
Component.Responsibility: Manages state for YakuCalculationScreen, holds selected tiles, performs validation, and uses MahjongCalculator to determine valid Yaku.

Component.name: YakuData
Component.Responsibility: Holds static hardcoded list of Mahjong Yakus (YakuInfo) and their descriptions in Korean.

Component.name: MahjongCalculator
Component.Responsibility: The main orchestration engine that calculates Yaku, Fu, and total points for a given Mahjong hand and context.

Component.name: TileDetectionModel
Component.Responsibility: Abstract interface for detecting Mahjong tiles from raw camera frame data (ByteArray).

Component.name: AgariEvaluator
Component.Responsibility: Determines if a given set of tiles forms a valid winning hand (Agari).

Component.name: AppComponent
Component.Responsibility: The root DI component interface, implemented on each platform to provide dependencies like Platform and TileDetectionModel.

Component.name: TileRecognitionScreen
Component.Responsibility: Provides UI for picking images from Gallery or Camera, and displays spatial recognition of tiles categorized by Hand, Discards, and Melds. Renders visual bounding boxes (overlay) mapped correctly to the displayed image scale using Canvas.

Component.name: TileRecognitionScreenModel
Component.Responsibility: Manages state for image recognition, processes bounding boxes into spatial categories (Hand vs Discard vs Melds), explicitly returns box coordinate data for the UI, and falls back to dummy MockDataGenerator data if detection fails or is empty.

Component.name: ImagePicker
Component.Responsibility: Platform-agnostic interface for picking images. Natively prompts the user (using Action Sheet on iOS and Dialog on Android) to choose between Gallery or Camera.

Component.name: ImageBitmapDecoder
Component.Responsibility: Platform-agnostic interface for decoding byte arrays into ImageBitmap for UI preview.

Implementation.Detail: Implemented as AndroidPlatform in androidMain, providing Android-specific metadata.
Implemented as IosPlatform in iosMain, providing iOS-specific metadata.
AndroidAppComponent in androidMain provides Android-specific dependencies to the app.
IosAppComponent in iosMain provides iOS-specific dependencies, including CameraFeedManager.

DataFlowAndState.Description: UI state is held in Voyager ScreenModels using MutableStateFlow. Screens observe state via StateFlow.collectAsState(). User actions trigger ScreenModel methods that update state asynchronously using screenModelScope.
DataFlowAndState.Route: Added navigation from `MahjongScreen` to `YakuListScreen` via Voyager's `navigator.push(YakuListScreen())`.
Added navigation from `MahjongScreen` to `TileRecognitionScreen` via Voyager's `navigator.push(TileRecognitionScreen())`.
Added navigation from `MahjongScreen` to `YakuCalculationScreen` via Voyager's `navigator.push(YakuCalculationScreen())`.

StrictConventions.Rule: Zero-Fragmentation: 99.9% of code must reside in commonMain.
Navigation & State: Exclusively Voyager Screen and ScreenModel.
Dependency Injection: Kotlin-Inject via KSP (compile-time safe).
Resources: Compose Multiplatform Resources in commonMain/composeResources.
Platform Abstraction: Interfaces + DI; no logic in expect/actual.
Context Maintenance: Mandatory read/write of SUMMARY.xml for every task.
